newsitem.title: USA: Merrill names two to oversee Global Equity.
newsitem.headline: Merrill names two to oversee Global Equity.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co Inc said on Friday it named Peter Hoffman and Phil Jones to be jointly responsible for Global Equity Linked Origination.
The Global Equity group will be composed of convertible origination, equity derivatives for corporates, restricted stock sales and repurchase programs, the company said in a news release.
Hoffman, a managing director, has been with Merrill since 1986. Jones, also a managing director, joined the company in 1993.
The two executives will be working under Mike Ryan.
